plan: Keep print_original a pure accessor returning authored_text unchanged; guarantee it by never mutating any input anywhere in adapt (all output structures are freshly constructed).
Compute a single Fraction scale factor target_yield/recipe_yield and apply it when each ingredient (including catalog-introduced additional ingredients) is first materialized.
Select substitutions deterministically with a (priority, catalog-index) minimum over entries whose 'for' matches the ingredient name.

Resolve each ingredient with an iterative exclusion-chain loop: while the current name is excluded, apply the selected choice (quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording pairs, equipment add/remove, additional ingredients) and advance the name; a per-chain seen-set detects cycles; additional ingredients recurse through the same resolver so chained adaptations work.

Accumulate reasons ('no substitution for NAME', 'substitution cycle involving NAME', 'equipment NAME unavailable') and warnings in sets that never short-circuit, so every independently applicable reason is reported; sort both at the end.
Adjust equipment with substitution removals/additions, dedupe, sort, and verify membership in available_equipment; check component equipment the same way.
Defer wording changes: replay collected (old, new) pairs sequentially over instruction strings (top-level and component), warning when an 'old' string is absent at its point in the sequence.

Assemble the result dict: on any reason, possible=False with recipe=None and the choices considered so far; otherwise a complete adapted recipe at the target yield with sorted equipment, rewritten instructions, and empty reasons.
mechanisms: pure-construction non-mutation (fresh dicts/lists everywhere; authored_text passed through untouched)
Fraction yield-scale factor composed multiplicatively with per-substitution quantity_factor
deterministic (priority, catalog-index) minimum for catalog choice selection
iterative substitution-chain resolver with per-chain seen-set cycle detection
recursive resolution of catalog-introduced additional ingredients (chained substitutions and re-excluded introductions)
global reason/warning accumulator sets that collect all independent failures before deciding possibility
deferred sequential wording rewrite over final instruction strings with absence warnings
post-substitution equipment reconciliation (remove/add, dedupe, sort, availability check)
